   887	    cond_ids = cond_df["condition_id"].tolist() if not cond_df.empty and "condition_id" in cond_df.columns else ep_df["condition_id"].unique().tolist()
   888	    results: Dict[str, Any] = {"bootstrap_ci": {}, "mcnemar": {}, "wilcoxon": {}, "notes": []}
   889	    flat_rows: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
   890	
   891	    rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
   892	    n_boot = 10_000
   893	
   894	    # a) Bootstrap 95% CI per condition
   895	    for cid in cond_ids:
   896	        mask = ep_df["condition_id"] == cid
   897	        sub = ep_df[mask]
   898	        if sub.empty or "success" not in sub.columns:
   899	            continue
   900	        successes = sub["success"].astype(float).fillna(0).values
   901	        boot_means = [rng.choice(successes, size=len(successes), replace=True).mean() for _ in range(n_boot)]
   902	        ci_lo = float(np.percentile(boot_means, 2.5))
   903	        ci_hi = float(np.percentile(boot_means, 97.5))
   904	        results["bootstrap_ci"][cid] = {
   905	            "success_rate": float(successes.mean()),
   906	            "ci_lower_95": ci_lo,
   907	            "ci_upper_95": ci_hi,
   908	            "n_episodes": int(len(successes)),
   909	        }
   910	        flat_rows.append({
   911	            "comparison": cid,
   912	            "metric": "success_rate",
   913	            "test": "bootstrap_ci",
   914	            "statistic": float(successes.mean()),
   915	            "p_value": None,
   916	            "significant_05": None,
   917	            "ci_lower": ci_lo,
   918	            "ci_upper": ci_hi,
   919	        })
   920	
   921	    # b) McNemar's exact test and c) Wilcoxon signed-rank (per condition-pair)
   922	    if len(cond_ids) >= 2 and "task_id" in ep_df.columns:
   923	        for i in range(len(cond_ids)):
   924	            for j in range(i + 1, len(cond_ids)):
   925	                cid_a, cid_b = cond_ids[i], cond_ids[j]
   926	                df_a = ep_df[ep_df["condition_id"] == cid_a][["task_id", "success", "total_cost_usd", "p95_step_latency_ms"]].copy()
   927	                df_b = ep_df[ep_df["condition_id"] == cid_b][["task_id", "success", "total_cost_usd", "p95_step_latency_ms"]].copy()
   928	                merged = df_a.merge(df_b, on="task_id", suffixes=("_a", "_b"))
   929	                if merged.empty:
   930	                    results["notes"].append(f"No paired tasks for {cid_a} vs {cid_b}")
   931	                    continue
   932	
   933	                pair_key = f"{cid_a}_vs_{cid_b}"
   934	
   935	                # McNemar
   936	                if {"success_a", "success_b"}.issubset(merged.columns):
   937	                    try:
   938	                        a_succ = merged["success_a"].astype(float).fillna(0).astype(bool)
   939	                        b_succ = merged["success_b"].astype(float).fillna(0).astype(bool)
   940	                        n00 = int((~a_succ & ~b_succ).sum())
   941	                        n01 = int((~a_succ & b_succ).sum())
   942	                        n10 = int((a_succ & ~b_succ).sum())
   943	                        n11 = int((a_succ & b_succ).sum())
   944	                        # McNemar exact test via binomial (scipy has no mcnemar)
   945	                        n_discordant = n01 + n10
   946	                        stat = float(min(n01, n10))
   947	                        if n_discordant == 0:
   948	                            p_val = 1.0
   949	                        else:
   950	                            from scipy.stats import binomtest
   951	                            bres = binomtest(n10, n_discordant, 0.5, alternative='two-sided')
   952	                            p_val = float(bres.pvalue)
   953	                        results["mcnemar"][pair_key] = {
   954	                            "statistic": stat,
   955	                            "p_value": p_val,
   956	                            "significant_05": p_val < 0.05,
   957	                            "contingency": {"n11": n11, "n10": n10, "n01": n01, "n00": n00},
   958	                        }
   959	                        flat_rows.append({
   960	                            "comparison": pair_key,
   961	                            "metric": "success",
   962	                            "test": "mcnemar_exact",
   963	                            "statistic": stat,
   964	                            "p_value": p_val,
   965	                            "significant_05": p_val < 0.05,
   966	                            "ci_lower": None,
   967	                            "ci_upper": None,
   968	                        })
   969	                    except Exception as exc:
   970	                        results["notes"].append(f"McNemar failed for {pair_key}: {exc}")
   971	
   972	                # Wilcoxon for cost and latency
   973	                for metric, col_a, col_b in [
   974	                    ("total_cost_usd", "total_cost_usd_a", "total_cost_usd_b"),
   975	                    ("p95_step_latency_ms", "p95_step_latency_ms_a", "p95_step_latency_ms_b"),
   976	                ]:
   977	                    if col_a not in merged.columns or col_b not in merged.columns:
   978	                        continue
   979	                    a_vals = pd.to_numeric(merged[col_a], errors="coerce").dropna()
   980	                    b_vals = pd.to_numeric(merged[col_b], errors="coerce").dropna()
   981	                    # Align by index
   982	                    common_idx = a_vals.index.intersection(b_vals.index)
   983	                    if len(common_idx) < 5:
   984	                        results["notes"].append(f"Wilcoxon {metric} {pair_key}: too few paired samples ({len(common_idx)})")
   985	                        continue

   987	                        wres = scipy_stats.wilcoxon(
   988	                            a_vals.loc[common_idx].values,
   989	                            b_vals.loc[common_idx].values,
   990	                            alternative="two-sided",

   993	                        stat = float(wres.statistic)

   996	                            "metric": metric,
   997	                            "statistic": stat,
   998	                            "p_value": p_val,
   999	                            "significant_05": p_val < 0.05,
  1000	                            "n_pairs": len(common_idx),

  1006	                            "statistic": stat,

  1010	                            "ci_upper": None,

    66	def _extract_stub_adjusted_sr(stub_note: str) -> Optional[float]:
    67	    """Parse 'Adjusted SR=19/234' pattern from stub note."""
    68	    m = re.search(r"[Aa]djusted SR[=:\s]*([\d]+)[/\s]*([\d]+)", stub_note)

    84	def load_conditions(run_dir: Path, model_label: str) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
    85	    """Load condition summaries keyed by observation_mode.
    86	
    87	    Returns {mode: cond_dict} for all modes found in run_dir. Also attempts
    88	    to enrich each cond with adjusted_sr from cross_representation_summary.json
    89	    so non-stub conditions get a real adjusted SR (was: always None).
    90	    """
    91	    result: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
    92	    for p in run_dir.glob("*/condition_summary_v2.json"):
    93	        try:
    94	            d = _read_json(p)
    95	            mode = d.get("observation_mode", "")

   103	    cross_rep_per_site: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
   104	    for pattern in [
   105	        "analysis/results/cross_representation/cross_representation_summary.json",
   106	        "analysis/results/cross_representation/*/cross_representation_summary.json",
   107	    ]:
   108	        for cp in run_dir.glob(pattern):
   109	            try:
   110	                cross_rep_per_site = _read_json(cp).get("per_site")
   111	                break
   112	            except Exception:
   113	                pass
   114	        if cross_rep_per_site:
   115	            break
   116	    if cross_rep_per_site:
   117	        for site_block in cross_rep_per_site.values():
   118	            if not isinstance(site_block, dict):
   119	                continue
   120	            per_mode_adj = site_block.get("per_mode_sr_adjusted") or {}
   121	            for mode, adj in per_mode_adj.items():
   122	                if mode in result:

   124	            # Single-site run: stop after first site block with data.

   130	def _get_adjusted_sr(cond: Dict[str, Any]) -> Optional[float]:

   134	    if "_adjusted_sr_xrep" in cond:
   135	        return float(cond["_adjusted_sr_xrep"])
   136	    return None

   140	    """Return the best available SR (adjusted if requested and available, else raw)."""
   141	    raw = float(cond.get("success_rate", 0.0))
   142	    if not use_adjusted:
   143	        return raw
   144	    adj = _get_adjusted_sr(cond)
   145	    return adj if adj is not None else raw

   160	    for model_label, cond_map in [("B0", b0_conds), ("B1", b1_conds)]:

   122	    parts = run_dir.parts

   142	
   143	def check_required_files(run_dir: Path) -> CheckResult:
   144	    """C01: Check that required analysis/condition files exist."""
   145	    missing = []
   146	    analysis = run_dir / "analysis"

   152	    # condition_metrics.csv

   162	
   163	    total_expected = 2 + len(list(_condition_dirs(run_dir)))
   164	    found = total_expected - len(missing)

   218	def check_condition_completeness(run_dir: Path) -> CheckResult:
   219	    """C03: Check that all expected conditions exist."""

   301	        mode = meta.get("observation_mode")
   302	        if mode:
   303	            mapping[cid] = mode
   304	    # Fallback: from reason_rows observation_mode column
   305	    if "observation_mode" in reason_df.columns:
   306	        for cid in reason_df["condition_id"].unique():
   307	            if cid not in mapping:
   308	                subset = reason_df[reason_df["condition_id"] == cid]
   309	                modes = subset["observation_mode"].dropna().unique()
   310	                if len(modes) == 1:
   311	                    mapping[cid] = modes[0]
   312	                elif len(modes) > 1:
   313	                    print(
   314	                        f"  [WARN] condition_id={cid} has multiple observation_modes "
   315	                        f"{modes.tolist()} in reason_df; dropping (its tasks will be "
   316	                        f"excluded from per-mode analysis)"
   317	                    )
   318	    return mapping
   319	
   320	
   321	def build_task_pivot(
   322	    reason_df: pd.DataFrame, cond_metas: Dict[str, Dict],
   323	) -> Tuple[pd.DataFrame, List[str]]:
   324	    """Pivot reason_df from (condition × task) rows to one row per (site, task_id)
   325	    with per-mode columns. Returns (pivot_df, sorted_modes)."""
   326	    cond_mode = _condition_to_mode(cond_metas, reason_df)
   327	    # Add mode column
   328	    df = reason_df.copy()
   329	    df["mode"] = df["condition_id"].map(cond_mode)
   330	    df = df.dropna(subset=["mode"])
   331	
   332	    modes = sorted(df["mode"].unique())
   333	
   334	    # Base task-level info (from first available row per task)
   335	    task_cols = ["site", "task_id", "task_type", "eval_type", "task_intent", "require_reset"]
   336	    available_task_cols = [c for c in task_cols if c in df.columns]
   337	    base = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["site", "task_id"])[available_task_cols].copy()
   338	
   339	    # Per-mode columns
   340	    per_mode_fields = ["success", "reason_bucket", "steps", "final_action_type", "fallback_finish", "page_unchanged_rate", "has_effective_action", "url_unique_count"]
   341	    for mode in modes:
   342	        mode_df = df[df["mode"] == mode][["site", "task_id"] + per_mode_fields].copy()
   343	        mode_df = mode_df.rename(columns={f: f"{mode}_{f}" for f in per_mode_fields})
   344	        base = base.merge(mode_df, on=["site", "task_id"], how="outer")
   345	
   346	    base = base.sort_values(["site", "task_id"]).reset_index(drop=True)
   347	    return base, modes
   348

   350	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   351	# False-positive detection (N/A FP + Eval FP; visual_fp removed in §95)
   352	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   353	
   354	
   355	def _infer_benchmark(run_dir: Optional[Path]) -> str:
   356	    """Infer benchmark from run_dir path (e.g. results/webarena/... -> 'webarena')."""
   357	    if run_dir is not None:
   358	        for part in run_dir.parts:
   359	            if part == "webarena":
   360	                return "webarena"
   361	    return "visualwebarena"
   362	
   363	
   364	def _mark_false_positives(
   365	    pivot: pd.DataFrame, modes: List[str], *, run_dir: Optional[Path] = None,
   366	) -> pd.DataFrame:
   367	    """Add is_na_task + {mode}_na_fp + {mode}_eval_fp + {mode}_success_adj columns.
   368	
   369	    N/A FP: any mode + N/A task + raw success + ~agent_finished.
   370	    Eval FP (§95 simplified):
   371	      string_match + success + ~agent_finished → always E-FP
   372	      program_html + success + ~agent_finished + ~has_effective_action → E-FP
   373	      url_match excluded: navigating to correct page without finish is legitimate.
   374	    """
   375	    from p79.experiment.analysis import _load_na_task_ids
   376	
   377	    # episode_reason_rows.csv does not currently carry a `benchmark`
   378	    # column, so this almost always falls through to path-based
   379	    # inference; left here in case the schema gains the column later.
   380	    _bm = "visualwebarena"
   381	    if "benchmark" in pivot.columns and not pivot.empty:
   382	        _bm = str(pivot["benchmark"].iloc[0])
   383	    elif run_dir is not None:
   384	        _bm = _infer_benchmark(run_dir)
   385	    na_ids_by_site: Dict[str, set] = {}
   386	    for site in pivot["site"].unique():
   387	        na_ids_by_site[site] = _load_na_task_ids(str(site), _bm)
   388	
   389	    pivot["is_na_task"] = pivot.apply(
   390	        lambda r: int(r["task_id"]) in na_ids_by_site.get(r["site"], set()),
   391	        axis=1,
   392	    )
   393	
   394	    # Compute agent_finished per mode (active finish, not fallback).
   395	    # Mirror canonical p79.experiment.analysis.compute_adjusted_success:
   396	    #   - na_fp is strict: missing/unknown agent_finished → flag as FP
   397	    #     (we accomplish this by setting af_col=False when data missing,
   398	    #      which makes nfp_col = is_na & success & ~False = True)
   399	    #   - eval_fp is permissive: missing/unknown → skip (don't flag)
   400	    #     (gated by af_known_col below)
   401	    for m in modes:
   402	        fat_col = f"{m}_final_action_type"
   403	        ff_col = f"{m}_fallback_finish"
   404	        af_col = f"{m}_agent_finished"
   405	        af_known_col = f"{m}_agent_finished_known"
   406	        if fat_col in pivot.columns and ff_col in pivot.columns:
   407	            ff_series = pivot[ff_col].fillna(False).astype(bool)
   408	            pivot[af_col] = (
   409	                pivot[fat_col].astype(str).str.lower().isin(["finish", "stop"])
   410	                & ~ff_series
   411	            )
   412	            pivot[af_known_col] = pivot[fat_col].notna()
   413	        else:
   414	            # Missing schema → treat as "agent_finished unknown".
   415	            pivot[af_col] = False  # strict for na_fp
   416	            pivot[af_known_col] = False  # blocks eval_fp
   417	
   418	    # Mark false positives and build adjusted success columns
   419	    na_fp_count: Dict[str, int] = {}
   420	    eval_fp_count: Dict[str, int] = {}
   421	
   422	    _is_string_match = pd.Series(False, index=pivot.index)
   423	    _is_program_html = pd.Series(False, index=pivot.index)
   424	    if "eval_type" in pivot.columns:
   425	        _et = pivot["eval_type"].astype(str)
   426	        _is_string_match = _et.str.contains("string_match", na=False)
   427	        _is_program_html = _et.str.contains("program_html", na=False)
   428	
   429	    for m in modes:
   430	        scol = f"{m}_success"
   431	        nfp_col = f"{m}_na_fp"
   432	        efp_col = f"{m}_eval_fp"
   433	        adj_col = f"{m}_success_adj"
   434	        af_col = f"{m}_agent_finished"
   435	        af_known_col = f"{m}_agent_finished_known"
   436	        if scol not in pivot.columns:
   437	            continue
   438	        pivot[nfp_col] = pivot["is_na_task"] & (pivot[scol] == True) & ~pivot[af_col]
   439	        # Eval FP: string_match always; program_html + ~has_effective_action.
   440	        # Gate on af_known to avoid over-flagging when agent_finished can't be
   441	        # determined from data (matches canonical compute_adjusted_success).
   442	        _hea_col = f"{m}_has_effective_action"
   443	        _hea = pivot[_hea_col].fillna(True).astype(bool) if _hea_col in pivot.columns else pd.Series(True, index=pivot.index)
   444	        _efp_eligible_m = _is_string_match | (_is_program_html & ~_hea)
   445	        pivot[efp_col] = (
   446	            _efp_eligible_m
   447	            & (pivot[scol] == True)
   448	            & pivot[af_known_col]
   449	            & ~pivot[af_col]
   450	            & ~pivot[nfp_col]
   451	        )
   452	        pivot[adj_col] = pivot[scol].copy()
   453	        pivot.loc[pivot[nfp_col] | pivot[efp_col], adj_col] = False
   454	        na_fp_count[m] = int(pivot[nfp_col].sum())
   455	        eval_fp_count[m] = int(pivot[efp_col].sum())
   456	
   457	    n_na = int(pivot["is_na_task"].sum())
   458	    fp_na_total = sum(na_fp_count.values())
   459	    fp_eval_total = sum(eval_fp_count.values())
   460	    print(f"  N/A FP: {n_na} N/A tasks, {fp_na_total} false positives {na_fp_count}")
   461	    print(f"  Eval FP: {fp_eval_total} false positives {eval_fp_count}")
   462	    return pivot, na_fp_count, eval_fp_count
   463

   477	
   478	def _compute_set_metrics(
   479	    pivot: pd.DataFrame, modes: List[str], success_suffix: str = "_success",
   480	) -> Dict[str, Any]:
   481	    """Compute set analysis metrics using the given success column suffix.
   482	
   483	    Args:
   484	        success_suffix: "_success" for raw, "_success_adj" for adjusted.
   485	    """
   486	    n_tasks = len(pivot)
   487	    if n_tasks == 0:
   488	        return {}
   489	
   490	    mode_sets: Dict[str, set] = {}
   491	    mode_sr: Dict[str, float] = {}
   492	    for m in modes:
   493	        col = f"{m}{success_suffix}"
   494	        if col in pivot.columns:
   495	            s = set(pivot.loc[pivot[col] == True, ["site", "task_id"]].apply(tuple, axis=1))
   496	            mode_sets[m] = s
   497	            mode_sr[m] = _safe_ratio(len(s), n_tasks)
   498	        else:
   499	            mode_sets[m] = set()
   500	            mode_sr[m] = 0.0
   501	
   502	    all_sets = [s for s in mode_sets.values() if s]
   503	    union_set = set().union(*all_sets) if all_sets else set()
   504	    intersection_set = set.intersection(*all_sets) if all_sets else set()
   505	
   506	    union_sr = _safe_ratio(len(union_set), n_tasks)
   507	    intersection_sr = _safe_ratio(len(intersection_set), n_tasks)
   508	    best_single = max(mode_sr.values()) if mode_sr else 0.0
   509	    best_single_mode = max(mode_sr, key=mode_sr.get) if mode_sr else ""
   510	
   511	    # Feature oracle: per (task_type, eval_type) pick best mode
   512	    feature_oracle_sr = 0.0
   513	    feature_oracle_choices: Dict[str, Any] = {}
   514	    type_cols = []
   515	    if "task_type" in pivot.columns:
   516	        type_cols.append("task_type")
   517	    if "eval_type" in pivot.columns:
   518	        type_cols.append("eval_type")
   519	
   520	    if type_cols:
   521	        grouped = pivot.groupby(type_cols)
   522	        weighted_successes = 0
   523	        for group_key, group_df in grouped:
   524	            group_sr: Dict[str, float] = {}
   525	            for m in modes:
   526	                col = f"{m}{success_suffix}"
   527	                if col in group_df.columns:
   528	                    group_sr[m] = group_df[col].sum() / len(group_df) if len(group_df) else 0
   529	            if group_sr:
   530	                best_mode = max(group_sr, key=group_sr.get)
   531	                weighted_successes += group_sr[best_mode] * len(group_df)
   532	                feature_oracle_choices[str(group_key)] = {
   533	                    "best_mode": best_mode,
   534	                    "sr": group_sr[best_mode],
   535	                    "n_tasks": len(group_df),
   536	                    "all_sr": {m: round(v, 4) for m, v in group_sr.items()},
   537	                }
   538	        feature_oracle_sr = _safe_ratio(weighted_successes, n_tasks)
   539	
   540	    perfect_headroom = union_sr - best_single
   541	    feature_headroom = feature_oracle_sr - best_single
   542	    feature_gap = union_sr - feature_oracle_sr
   543	
   544	    mode_n_tested: Dict[str, int] = {}
   545	    for m in modes:
   546	        col = f"{m}{success_suffix}"
   547	        if col in pivot.columns:
   548	            mode_n_tested[m] = int(pivot[col].notna().sum())
   549	        else:
   550	            mode_n_tested[m] = 0
   551	
   552	    return {
   553	        "n_tasks": n_tasks,
   554	        "modes": modes,
   555	        "per_mode_sr": {m: round(v, 4) for m, v in mode_sr.items()},
   556	        "per_mode_success_count": {m: len(s) for m, s in mode_sets.items()},
   557	        "per_mode_n_tested": mode_n_tested,
   558	        "per_mode_sr_tested": {
   559	            m: round(_safe_ratio(len(mode_sets[m]), mode_n_tested[m]), 4)
   560	            for m in modes
   561	        },
   562	        "union_sr": round(union_sr, 4),
   563	        "union_count": len(union_set),
   564	        "intersection_sr": round(intersection_sr, 4),
   565	        "intersection_count": len(intersection_set),
   566	        "best_single_mode": best_single_mode,
   567	        "best_single_sr": round(best_single, 4),
   568	        "perfect_oracle_ceiling": round(union_sr, 4),
   569	        "feature_oracle_ceiling": round(feature_oracle_sr, 4),
   570	        "perfect_headroom": round(perfect_headroom, 4),
   571	        "feature_headroom": round(feature_headroom, 4),
   572	        "feature_gap": round(feature_gap, 4),
   573	        "feature_oracle_choices": feature_oracle_choices,
   574	        "_mode_sets": mode_sets,
   575	        "_union_set": union_set,
   576	        "_intersection_set": intersection_set,
   577	    }
   578	
   579	
   580	def a2_set_analysis(
   581	    pivot: pd.DataFrame, modes: List[str], dirs: OutputDirs,
   582	    na_fp_count: Optional[Dict[str, int]] = None,
   583	    eval_fp_count: Optional[Dict[str, int]] = None,
   584	) -> Dict:
   585	    """A2: Set analysis + dual-layer oracle ceiling (raw + adjusted)."""
   586	    if len(pivot) == 0:
   587	        return {}
   588	
   589	    # --- Raw metrics ---
   590	    raw = _compute_set_metrics(pivot, modes, "_success")
   591	    union_set = raw.pop("_union_set")
   592	    intersection_set = raw.pop("_intersection_set")
   593	    raw.pop("_mode_sets")
   594	
   595	    # --- Adjusted metrics (na_fp + eval_fp; visual_fp removed in §95) ---
   596	    has_adj = any(f"{m}_success_adj" in pivot.columns for m in modes)
   597	    if has_adj:
   598	        adj = _compute_set_metrics(pivot, modes, "_success_adj")
   599	        adj.pop("_union_set", None)
   600	        adj.pop("_intersection_set", None)
   601	        adj.pop("_mode_sets", None)
   602	        raw["per_mode_sr_adjusted"] = adj["per_mode_sr"]
   603	        raw["per_mode_success_count_adjusted"] = adj["per_mode_success_count"]
   604	        raw["per_mode_sr_tested_adjusted"] = adj["per_mode_sr_tested"]
   605	        raw["union_sr_adjusted"] = adj["union_sr"]
   606	        raw["union_count_adjusted"] = adj["union_count"]
   607	        raw["intersection_sr_adjusted"] = adj["intersection_sr"]
   608	        raw["intersection_count_adjusted"] = adj["intersection_count"]
   609	        raw["best_single_mode_adjusted"] = adj["best_single_mode"]
   610	        raw["best_single_sr_adjusted"] = adj["best_single_sr"]
   611	        raw["perfect_oracle_ceiling_adjusted"] = adj["perfect_oracle_ceiling"]
   612	        raw["feature_oracle_ceiling_adjusted"] = adj["feature_oracle_ceiling"]
   613	        raw["perfect_headroom_adjusted"] = adj["perfect_headroom"]
   614	        raw["feature_headroom_adjusted"] = adj["feature_headroom"]
   615	        raw["feature_gap_adjusted"] = adj["feature_gap"]
   616	        raw["feature_oracle_choices_adjusted"] = adj["feature_oracle_choices"]
   617	    if na_fp_count is not None:
   618	        raw["na_fp_count"] = na_fp_count
   619	    if eval_fp_count is not None:
   620	        raw["eval_fp_count"] = eval_fp_count

   657	def _compute_exclusive_sets(
   658	    pivot: pd.DataFrame, modes: List[str], success_suffix: str = "_success",
   659	) -> Tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame, str]:
   660	    """Compute exclusive set summary + detail using the given success suffix.
   661	
   662	    Returns (summary_df, pivot_with_exclusive_set_col, set_col_name).
   663	
   664	    Each task is classified into a tri-state vector per mode:
   665	      True  → tested and succeeded
   666	      False → tested and failed
   667	      None  → not tested (column missing or NaN value)
   668	    Untested modes are reported in the set name explicitly so they are not
   669	    silently conflated with failure (which would inflate "only_X" buckets
   670	    when modes have asymmetric task coverage).
   671	    """
   672	    def _success_vector(row):
   673	        out = []
   674	        for m in modes:
   675	            col = f"{m}{success_suffix}"
   676	            if col not in row.index:
   677	                out.append(None)
   678	                continue
   679	            v = row[col]
   680	            if v is None or (isinstance(v, float) and np.isnan(v)) or pd.isna(v):
   681	                out.append(None)
   682	            else:
   683	                out.append(bool(v))
   684	        return tuple(out)
   685	
   686	    pivot_c = pivot.copy()
   687	    pivot_c["_svec"] = pivot_c.apply(_success_vector, axis=1)
   688	
   689	    def _set_name(svec: tuple) -> str:
   690	        successes = [modes[i] for i, v in enumerate(svec) if v is True]
   691	        failures = [modes[i] for i, v in enumerate(svec) if v is False]
   692	        untested = [modes[i] for i, v in enumerate(svec) if v is None]
   693	        # Build base classification over tested modes only.
   694	        if not successes and not failures:
   695	            return "all_untested"
   696	        if not successes:
   697	            base = "all_tested_fail"
   698	        elif not failures:
   699	            base = "all_tested_success" if untested else "all_success"
   700	        elif len(successes) == 1:
   701	            base = f"only_{successes[0]}"
   702	        else:
   703	            base = "_and_".join(successes) + "_not_" + "_".join(failures)
   704	        if untested:
   705	            return base + "_untested_" + "_".join(untested)
   706	        # No untested modes → restore the legacy "all_fail" / "all_success"
   707	        # labels for backward-compat with downstream consumers.
   708	        if base == "all_tested_fail":
   709	            return "all_fail"
   710	        return base
   711	
   712	    set_col = "exclusive_set" if success_suffix == "_success" else "exclusive_set_adj"
   713	    pivot_c[set_col] = pivot_c["_svec"].apply(_set_name)
   714	
   715	    summary_rows = []
   716	    for sname, grp in pivot_c.groupby(set_col):
   717	        tt_dist = dict(Counter(grp.get("task_type", pd.Series(dtype=str)).dropna()))
   718	        summary_rows.append({
   719	            "exclusive_set": sname,
   720	            "count": len(grp),
   721	            "pct": round(len(grp) / len(pivot_c), 4),
   722	            "task_type_distribution": json.dumps(tt_dist),
   723	        })
   724	
   725	    summary_df = pd.DataFrame(summary_rows).sort_values("count", ascending=False)
   726	    return summary_df, pivot_c, set_col
   727	
   728	
   729	def a3_exclusive_sets(pivot: pd.DataFrame, modes: List[str], dirs: OutputDirs) -> None:
   730	    """A3: Enumerate exclusive success/failure sets with task_type distribution."""
   731	    n_modes = len(modes)
   732	    if n_modes == 0:
   733	        return
   734	
   735	    # --- Raw ---
   736	    summary_df, pivot_c, set_col = _compute_exclusive_sets(pivot, modes, "_success")
   737	    summary_df.to_csv(dirs.tables / "A3_exclusive_sets_summary.csv", index=False)
   738	
   739	    detail_cols = ["site", "task_id", set_col]
   740	    if "task_type" in pivot_c.columns:
   741	        detail_cols.append("task_type")
   742	    if "task_intent" in pivot_c.columns:
   743	        detail_cols.append("task_intent")
   744	    for m in modes:
   745	        detail_cols.extend([f"{m}_success", f"{m}_reason_bucket"])
   746	    detail_cols = [c for c in detail_cols if c in pivot_c.columns]
   747	    pivot_c[detail_cols].to_csv(dirs.tables / "A3_exclusive_sets_detail.csv", index=False)
   748	
   749	    print(f"  A3: {len(summary_df)} exclusive sets")
   750	    for _, r in summary_df.iterrows():

   785	def a4_cost_at_success(
   786	    pivot: pd.DataFrame, modes: List[str], ep_summaries: pd.DataFrame,
   787	    cond_mode: Dict[str, str], dirs: OutputDirs,
   788	) -> None:
   789	    """A4: Cost comparison for tasks that succeed in ALL present modes."""
   790	    if ep_summaries.empty:
   791	        print("  A4: skipped (no episode summaries)")
   792	        return
   793	
   794	    # Filter to intersection tasks (must be True, not NaN, in ALL modes)
   795	    success_cols = [
   796	        f"{m}_success_adj" if f"{m}_success_adj" in pivot.columns else f"{m}_success"
   797	        for m in modes
   798	    ]
   799	    success_cols = [c for c in success_cols if c in pivot.columns]
   800	    mask = pivot[success_cols].apply(lambda row: all(v == True for v in row), axis=1)
   801	    inter_tasks = set(pivot.loc[mask, ["site", "task_id"]].apply(tuple, axis=1))
   802	    if not inter_tasks:
   803	        print("  A4: skipped (no tasks succeed in all modes)")
   804	        return
   805	
   806	    # Add mode to summaries
   807	    mode_col = "condition_id"
   808	    if mode_col not in ep_summaries.columns:
   809	        print("  A4: skipped (no condition_id in summaries)")
   810	        return
   811	    es = ep_summaries.copy()
   812	    es["mode"] = es["condition_id"].map(cond_mode)
   813	    es = es.dropna(subset=["mode"])
   814	    # Resolve site per-row: prefer benchmark_site, fall back to site
   815	    # only when benchmark_site is missing on that row.
   816	    if "benchmark_site" in es.columns and "site" in es.columns:
   817	        es["_site_resolved"] = es["benchmark_site"].fillna(es["site"])
   818	    elif "benchmark_site" in es.columns:
   819	        es["_site_resolved"] = es["benchmark_site"]
   820	    elif "site" in es.columns:
   821	        es["_site_resolved"] = es["site"]
   822	    else:
   823	        es["_site_resolved"] = ""
   824	    es["_key"] = list(zip(es["_site_resolved"], es["task_id"]))
   825	    es = es[es["_key"].isin(inter_tasks)]
   826	
   827	    cost_fields = [
   828	        "total_cost_usd", "total_latency_ms", "total_tokens",
   829	        "total_energy_kwh", "steps",
   830	    ]
   831	    available_fields = [f for f in cost_fields if f in es.columns]
   832	
   833	    # Pivot to per-task, per-mode
   834	    rows = []
   835	    for key, grp in es.groupby("_key"):
   836	        site_val = key[0] if isinstance(key, tuple) else key
   837	        tid_val = key[1] if isinstance(key, tuple) else grp.iloc[0]["task_id"]
   838	        row = {"site": site_val, "task_id": tid_val}
   839	        for _, er in grp.iterrows():
   840	            m = er["mode"]
   841	            for f in available_fields:
   842	                row[f"{m}_{f}"] = er.get(f)
   843	        # Cheapest mode
   844	        mode_costs = {m: row.get(f"{m}_total_cost_usd") for m in modes}
   845	        mode_costs = {m: v for m, v in mode_costs.items() if v is not None}
   846	        if mode_costs:
   847	            row["cheapest_mode"] = min(mode_costs, key=mode_costs.get)
   848	        rows.append(row)
   849	
   850	    if not rows:
   851	        print("  A4: skipped (no matched rows)")
   852	        return
   853	
   854	    cost_df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
   855	    cost_df.to_csv(dirs.tables / "A4_cost_at_success.csv", index=False)
   856	
   857	    # Summary stats
   858	    summary = {"n_tasks": len(cost_df)}
   859	    for m in modes:
   860	        m_stats = {}
   861	        for f in available_fields:
   862	            col = f"{m}_{f}"
   863	            if col in cost_df.columns:
   864	                vals = cost_df[col].dropna()
   865	                if len(vals):
   866	                    m_stats[f] = {"mean": round(vals.mean(), 6), "median": round(vals.median(), 6)}
   867	        summary[m] = m_stats
   868	
   869	    # Cheapest mode distribution
   870	    if "cheapest_mode" in cost_df.columns:
   871	        summary["cheapest_mode_distribution"] = dict(Counter(cost_df["cheapest_mode"]))
   872	
   873	    # Wilcoxon paired test on cost (if scipy available)
   874	    if HAS_SCIPY and len(modes) >= 2:
   875	        stat_tests = {}
   876	        for i in range(len(modes)):
   877	            for j in range(i + 1, len(modes)):
   878	                ma, mb = modes[i], modes[j]
   879	                ca = cost_df.get(f"{ma}_total_cost_usd")
   880	                cb = cost_df.get(f"{mb}_total_cost_usd")
   881	                if ca is not None and cb is not None:
   882	                    valid = ca.notna() & cb.notna()
   883	                    if valid.sum() >= 5:
   884	                        try:
   885	                            stat, p = scipy_stats.wilcoxon(ca[valid], cb[valid])
   886	                            stat_tests[f"{ma}_vs_{mb}"] = {
   887	                                "wilcoxon_stat": round(float(stat), 4),
   888	                                "p_value": round(float(p), 6),
   889	                                "n": int(valid.sum()),
   890	                            }
   891	                        except Exception:
   892	                            pass
   893	        if stat_tests:
   894	            summary["wilcoxon_tests"] = stat_tests
   895	
   896	    _write_json(summary, dirs.base / "A4_cost_at_success_summary.json")
   897	    print(f"  A4: {len(cost_df)} intersection tasks, cheapest_mode dist: "
   898	          f"{summary.get('cheapest_mode_distribution', {})}")
   899

   901	def a5_task_type_success_rate(
   902	    pivot: pd.DataFrame, modes: List[str], dirs: OutputDirs, skip_plots: bool,
   903	) -> None:
   904	    """A5: Task type × mode success rate breakdown (raw + adjusted)."""
   905	    if "task_type" not in pivot.columns:
   906	        print("  A5: skipped (no task_type)")
   907	        return
   908	
   909	    has_adj = any(f"{m}_success_adj" in pivot.columns for m in modes)
   910	
   911	    rows = []
   912	    for tt, grp in pivot.groupby("task_type"):
   913	        row = {"task_type": tt, "n_tasks": len(grp)}
   914	        for m in modes:
   915	            col = f"{m}_success"
   916	            if col in grp.columns:
   917	                n_success = grp[col].sum()
   918	                n_present = grp[col].notna().sum()
   919	                row[f"{m}_success_count"] = int(n_success)
   920	                row[f"{m}_n_present"] = int(n_present)
   921	                row[f"{m}_sr"] = round(_safe_ratio(n_success, n_present), 4)
   922	            # Adjusted
   923	            adj_col = f"{m}_success_adj"
   924	            if has_adj and adj_col in grp.columns:
   925	                n_adj = grp[adj_col].sum()
   926	                n_present_adj = grp[adj_col].notna().sum()
   927	                row[f"{m}_success_count_adj"] = int(n_adj)
   928	                row[f"{m}_sr_adj"] = round(_safe_ratio(n_adj, n_present_adj), 4)
   929	        rows.append(row)
   930	
   931	    tt_df = pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("n_tasks", ascending=False)
   932	    tt_df.to_csv(dirs.tables / "A5_task_type_success_rate.csv", index=False)
   933	
   934	    # Plot
   935	    if not skip_plots and HAS_MPL and len(tt_df) > 0:
   936	        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(max(8, len(tt_df) * 1.5), 5))
   937	        x = np.arange(len(tt_df))
   938	        width = 0.8 / max(len(modes), 1)
   939	        for i, m in enumerate(modes):
   940	            sr_col = f"{m}_sr_adj" if f"{m}_sr_adj" in tt_df.columns else f"{m}_sr"
   941	            if sr_col in tt_df.columns:
   942	                vals = tt_df[sr_col].fillna(0)
   943	                ax.bar(x + i * width, vals, width, label=m)
   944	        ax.set_xticks(x + width * (len(modes) - 1) / 2)
   945	        ax.set_xticklabels(tt_df["task_type"], rotation=30, ha="right")
   946	        ax.set_ylabel("Success Rate")
   947	        ax.set_title("Success Rate by Task Type × Observation Mode (adjusted)")
   948	        ax.legend()
   949	        ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
   950	        fig.tight_layout()
   951	        fig.savefig(dirs.plots / "A5_task_type_success_rate.png", dpi=150)
   952	        plt.close(fig)
   953	
   954	    print(f"  A5: {len(tt_df)} task types")
